6759523718.description:
Cassini Camera is a palette-quantised photography instrument for iPhone.

It takes the 12-colour palette system from the Cassini ECS-1 drawing suite and applies it to a live camera feed. A Metal GPU shader reduces every frame to the nearest colours in your chosen palette at 30 frames per second. What you see in the viewfinder is what you get.

INSTRUMENT SPECIFICATIONS

- 12-colour palette quantisation via Metal compute shader
- 500 x 1000 live viewfinder at 30 FPS
- 2000 x 4000 output resolution (4x nearest-neighbour upscale)
- 16 built-in palettes
- Exposure compensation: ±3 EV in 0.3-stop steps
- All built-in lenses supported
- Direct save to Photos

CONTROLS

The interface is a skeuomorphic camera body. There are no menus, no settings screens, and no editing tools.

- Shutter wheel: tap to capture, spin to adjust exposure
- Palette button: cycle through 16 palettes
- Lens button: switch between cameras
- Sub-display: shows current palette, exposure, or lens
- Camera Control (iPhone 16): swipe to browse palettes, press to capture

HOW IT WORKS

The shader samples every pixel in the camera feed and maps it to the nearest colour in the active palette using Euclidean distance in RGB space. The result is written to the viewfinder in real time. When you tap the shutter, the current frame is upscaled 4x with nearest-neighbour interpolation and saved directly to your photo library.

PALETTES

Sixteen curated palettes are provided: Arafura, Spindrift, Sherbrooke, Chukhung, Poa Alpina, La Caldera, Shenzhou, Altostratus, Insolate, Daphnis 26, Hyperborea, Kobresia, Antennaria, Uva-Ursi, Endurium, and Laika. Each contains 12 colours chosen to produce distinct photographic character across a range of subjects.

COMPANION

Cassini Camera is a companion to the Cassini ECS-1 Electrographic Creation Suite for iPad. It shares the same palette library and the same philosophy: fewer choices, more deliberate work.

• Em, Am, E, A, D, G, C, Dm and the seventh chords, then sus, add and barre chords
• Every chord box can be heard: tap it and listen to how it should sound
• Microphone chord check: hold the shape, strum, and see which strings the app hears
• One-minute chord change drills, the exercise every guitar teacher gives

PLAY SONGS LIKE A GAME
• 62 songs with chords: Amazing Grace, House of the Rising Sun, Greensleeves, Jingle Bells, Wellerman, Bella Ciao, Ode to Joy, Silent Night, Twinkle Twinkle, Frère Jacques and more, plus classical melodies as tab
• Capo suggestions so the shapes stay easy and the song keeps its original key
• Strum once a bar, twice, or on every beat as you improve
• PERFECT+, PERFECT, GOOD or MISS on every strum, combo multipliers, stars and a score to beat
• A backing band plays along, so even two chords sound like real music

A REAL GUITAR COURSE
• Six levels and 450+ short interactive lessons: read, listen, play
• Holding the guitar, tuning, open chords, strumming patterns, seventh chords, colour chords, reading tab, barre chords
• Ear training: hear a chord and name it
• A lesson for every song in the catalogue, part by part

LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Wait for me: the song pauses until you strum the right chord; switch it off to play in tempo
• Slow the song down and turn the metronome click on or off
• Songs are split into parts: learn the verse, then the chorus, then play it through

BUILT-IN TUNER
• Tuner with automatic string detection for standard tuning
• Tap a string to hear the reference pitch

WHO IS IT FOR
• Complete beginners with an acoustic or electric guitar
• Kids and adults, no music theory required
• Anyone coming back to the guitar after years away
• Players who want to finally change chords without stopping

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tune up with the built-in tuner
2. Put your phone in front of you and pick a song or start the course
3. Strum along with the moving chord boxes and collect your stars

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no personal data, no ads
• Audio is analysed on your device and never recorded or uploaded
• Works offline

FREE AND PREMIUM
The first part of every song and lesson levels 1–2 are free, forever. Nota Guitar Premium unlocks every part of every song, whole-song mode and all six lesson levels. Panic attack right now? Open Pufflo and tap SOS. A soft, fluffy companion breathes with you, slowly, until the wave passes.

Pufflo is a self-help app for panic attacks and anxiety. It gives you something clear to do in the hardest minutes, and helps you understand panic in the calm ones.

WHEN PANIC HITS
• SOS in one tap from the home screen: breathe in for 4, out for 6, together with Pufflo.
• 5-4-3-2-1 grounding: notice what you see, touch and hear, and come back to the room.
• Comfort cards: short, steady words for the moment and for afterwards.
• Your trusted person and crisis help lines for 38 countries, one tap away.

CALM YOUR BODY
• Breathing exercises: long exhale, box breathing, 4-7-8, double inhale sigh, even five.
• Grounding guides: feet on the floor, cool water reset, body scan, muscle release.
• Calming games: pop a bubble on every slow breath out, trace a wave, squeeze and let go.

UNDERSTAND PANIC
• 14 short lessons on what a panic attack is, why the body does it and what loosens its grip. Every lesson lists its sources.
• Thought check: a simple CBT-style way to weigh a scary thought.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• A private journal of attacks, daily check-ins and thought checks.
• Insights: attacks per week, common triggers, intensity before and after.
• A PDF report you can show your doctor or therapist.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your journal stays on your iPhone and is not uploaded.

PUFFLO PRO
SOS, the journal, two breathing rhythms, 5-4-3-2-1, the Bubbles game, the first three lessons and part of the comfort cards are open to everyone. Pufflo Pro opens every breathing rhythm, grounding guide, game, lesson and comfort card, unlimited thought checks, 8-week insights and the PDF report. Pro is an auto-renewing weekly or yearly subscription, or a single lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

IMPORTANT
Pufflo offers self-help tools and general education. It is not a medical device and does not provide diagnosis, treatment or emergency care. If you are in danger, or your symptoms are new or severe, call your local emergency number or talk to a doctor.

Plan any room to the inch – or to the centimeter. Roomtect is a home and room planner built around real measurements: draw your floor plan, place furniture at its true size and check that everything fits before you buy, build or move.

DRAW A FLOOR PLAN IN MINUTES
• Tap the corners to draw walls: they snap to corners, to 45° and 90° and to a 5 cm grid
• Or add a room by typing its width and length
• Every wall shows its length – type an exact length in centimeters or inches
• Split or straighten walls and see each room's area in m² or ft²
• Start from a template – rectangle, L-shaped room, studio with bathroom, two rooms with a hall – or open the furnished sample apartment
• Undo and redo; every change is saved automatically

SCAN A ROOM WITH LIDAR
On devices with a LiDAR scanner, walk around the room for about a minute: Roomtect captures the walls, doors, windows and furniture and turns them into a plan you can edit.

DOORS AND WINDOWS
Door, double door, sliding door, window, wide window and open passage – choose the swing side and the hinge.

FURNITURE IN REAL SIZES
• 195 pieces in 14 sections: living room, bedroom, kids, dining, kitchen, bathroom, office, storage, lighting, electronics, outdoor, fixtures (stairs, columns, radiators, boilers, air conditioners), hobbies and decor
• The whole catalog is included and searchable, and every piece is resizable – type its width, depth and height, or pick a standard size
• Wall cabinets, shelves, pictures and lights hang at their real height; lamps, microwaves and TVs stand on the piece below
• 10 color finishes, or any color with Pro; pieces snap neatly against walls

WILL IT FIT? (PRO)
Roomtect flags furniture that overlaps another piece, goes through a wall or blocks the swing of a door. Heights are taken into account, so a wall cabinet above the counter is fine.

SEE IT IN 3D
Turn the plan into a 3D model you can orbit. Switch between low and full walls, choose floors – oak, walnut, ash, parquet, marble, concrete, terrazzo, carpet, and plain, checkerboard or hexagon tiles – and finish the walls with paint, tiles, brick, wood panels or wallpaper, room by room (wall finishes with Pro).

SEVERAL FLOORS
Keep every floor of a house in one project.

AUGMENTED REALITY (PRO)
See furniture at its real size in your room, or put the whole plan on a table as a model.

EXPORT TO SCALE (PRO)
Export a PDF to scale (1:20 to 1:1000 on A4) with every dimension and room area printed, or a PNG image – ready for your contractor, carpenter or landlord.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no sign-in. Your plans stay on your device and the app works without an internet connection.

ROOMTECT PRO
Included without Pro: one plan of your own plus the sample apartment, the full furniture catalog, room scan, 2D plan and 3D model.
Pro adds unlimited plans, PDF and PNG export, the Will-it-fit check, wall colors in 3D and AR.
